title: Saltkerns' coastal marsh around 'the Point' is a large, loosely-connected loop of ~15 samey rooms (tide pools, salt pans, reed cuts, dunes, etc.) with no map or bearings tool comparable to the Old Watchtower's 'get your bearings' in the Vale — easy to wander it at length without finding the quest objective it's meant to contain.
